title: Special Topics in National/International Cinemas; Italian Political Cinema
description:
Cross-listed with ITAL499Q. Credit only granted for ITAL499Q or CINE429X.

Focuses on political filmmaking in Italy, with particular attention given to the historical context of the so-called "long '68:" a moment of intense political, social, and cultural turmoil that spanned from the early Sixties to the mid-Eighties. We will look at Italy as a laboratory for new forms of radical militancy and state violence, and interrogate the ways in which cinema has given shape to this complex historical period. All films are in Italian with English subtitles.
